lines.text: Ishmael comes to Mizpah with ten men, eats a meal with Gedaliah, then strikes him down with the sword.
Eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria come with offerings for the house of the LORD, and Ishmael meets them weeping.
Ishmael slaughters the men and throws them into a cistern that King Ahab made for fear of Baasha.
Ishmael takes the people of Mizpah captive toward Moab, but Johanan finds him at Gibeon and the captives go over to Johanan.
Johanan leads the recovered remnant to Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem, planning to go to Egypt because they fear the Chaldeans.
